title: FraudxAI US Card Transactions (100k Synthetic)
subtitle: Synthetic 2.009% fraud rate, 46.91-day span, non-certified
description: 100,000 synthetic US payment-card transactions (91 columns) plus five institutional views of the same batch: authorization feed, gateway telemetry, clearing/settlement, dispute ledger and threat-intelligence graph. Generated by the FraudxAI discrete-event payment simulator with seed 42. Fraud prevalence is deliberately boosted to 2.009%, roughly 12x real card data (real ULB corpus: 0.1727%). Read README.md before use: dispute_recovery.csv carries the is_fraud label and must not be joined into features, the measured span is 46.91 days although 30 days were requested, and the generator is NON_CERTIFIED_FAIL under its own four-pillar benchmark.
